title: Connect Finance Chart of Accounts v1
description: One fiscal year's ledger accounts (names, QuickBooks-derived category paths, and each account's own actual/budget cents for that year) plus Finance's own board-category, display-name and purpose-tag presentation of them. Requested with ?fiscal_year=YYYY; without it, the church's current calendar year. No gift, donor, or person crosses this contract. The consumer validator also accepts the earlier year-less structural shape (no fiscalYear/availableFiscalYears, Income/Expenses accounts only, no dollar fields, dataClassification 'structural', the four original reconciliation counts) so a newer Finance keeps working against an older Connect.

fiscalYear.description: The year every account row and dollar figure belongs to.

availableFiscalYears.description: Every fiscal year with annual ledger rows, newest first. The requested year is not replaced by another when it has none.

accounts.description: The year's precedence-resolved ledger rows (resolveChurchYearPrecedence), in import order.

unassignedCount.description: Accounts with boardCategoryKey 'unassigned' -- Chart of Accounts is filled in gradually, so this is expected to be nonzero and is surfaced rather than hidden.

revenueActualCents.description: Sum of actualCents over Income and Other Income accounts.

expenseActualCents.description: Sum of actualCents over every other account.

displayName.description: The saved Chart of Accounts rename, else accountName.

actualCents.description: This account's own posted actual for fiscalYear (not including sub-accounts).

budgetCents.description: This account's own budget for fiscalYear; null when no budget is on file.

boardCategoryKey.description: One of the REVENUE_STREAMS / BOARD_EXPENSE_CATEGORIES keys, or 'unassigned' when Chart of Accounts has not saved one for this account (the consumer applies the name-based default).
